subject.title: Feature: Support custom anthropic_beta flags in Bedrock model config

question: Should the Bedrock plugin expose a broad `additionalModelRequestFields` or `providerFields` passthrough, a narrow typed `anthropicBeta` or `context1m` option, or decline user-configurable Bedrock beta flags?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but this adds a user-facing provider config contract; OpenClaw policy treats new config/default surfaces and provider routing as compatibility-sensitive product decisions.

options.title: Add Bedrock-owned request fields
options.body: Expose a Bedrock plugin or per-model params contract that safely merges request fields, validates shape, documents upgrade behavior, and covers `anthropic_beta` without creating a core-wide generic passthrough.

options.title: Add only a narrow beta flag
options.body: Support a typed Bedrock `anthropicBeta` or `context1m` path for Claude long context while avoiding a general Converse body passthrough.

options.title: Decline custom betas
options.body: Keep Bedrock request shaping internal and ask users to wait for first-class provider support for each beta feature.

recommendation.title: Add Bedrock-owned request fields
recommendation.body: Expose a Bedrock plugin or per-model params contract that safely merges request fields, validates shape, documents upgrade behavior, and covers `anthropic_beta` without creating a core-wide generic passthrough.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans provider/plugin boundary and config contract policy, and steipete appears in recent provider and Bedrock plugin history.
